d: Turkey has inducted its first unmanned fighter jet, marking a major step in the race to develop combat aircraft that can fly without pilots. The Kizilelma, built by Turkish defence firm Baykar, is designed to engage targets in the air and strike positions on the ground. In this video, Firstpost examines the jet's capabilities, its successful weapons tests and why Ankara is investing in pilotless combat aircraft.
